title: Pullback of the dual of a finite locally free module on a ringed site
statement:
Let $\mathcal C,\mathcal D$ be sites small relative to the universe of sheaves [def-weil-size-convention, def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology], with finite limits, and let $u:\mathcal C\to\mathcal D$ preserve finite limits and coverings. Let $f^{-1}:\operatorname{Sh}(\mathcal C)\to\operatorname{Sh}(\mathcal D)$ be the associated geometric inverse image [lem-weil-pbc-left-exact-site-inverse-image-tensor]. Let $R$ on $\mathcal C$ and $S$ on $\mathcal D$ be sheaves of commutative rings, with a ring map $c:f^{-1}R\to S$. For an $R$-module sheaf $N$ [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] put $f^*N=S\otimes_{f^{-1}R}f^{-1}N$, with sheaf tensor product [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product]. Let $L$ be an $R$-module sheaf that is finite locally free, meaning that there is a covering $\{V_i\to1_{\mathcal C}\}$ and integers $r_i\ge0$ with $L|_{V_i}\cong(R|_{V_i})^{\oplus r_i}$ on the localized sites [def-pur-localized-ringed-site]. Write $L^\vee=\mathcal Hom_R(L,R)$, using sheaf Hom [def-pur-sheaf-hom]. The canonical $S$-linear map
$$\delta_{f,L}:f^*(L^\vee)\longrightarrow\mathcal Hom_S(f^*L,S),$$
obtained from the pullback of the evaluation pairing $L^\vee\otimes_R L\to R$, the relative tensor comparison [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-module-pullback-tensor], and $f^*R\cong S$, is an isomorphism. It is natural contravariantly in $L$. On a pulled-back local basis $e_1,\ldots,e_{r_i}$ it sends the pulled-back dual basis functional $e_j^\vee$ to the functional taking $f^*e_k$ to $\delta_{jk}\cdot1_S$. No flatness assumption on $c$ is required.

proof.text: Construct the module left adjoint by lem-pur-ringed-site-module-pullback-exists-universes. Apply lem-pur-ringed-site-pullback-pairing-transfer to the identity on each internal dual. Its unique pairing extensions give the family delta and its evaluation equation. The family is uniquely determined componentwise by this same uniqueness.

For b:L → M apply the same pairing-transfer uniqueness to precomposition by b. Adjunction-unit naturality shows that both naturality composites evaluate on (phi,m) as a(phi(b(m))); hence both equal the unique transfer. This is the explicit Lean naturality proof.

Map the given covering sieve through U. Finite-limit preservation makes U(1_C) terminal. The pushed-forward sieve is contained in the sieve of objects U(V_i), so these objects cover D. Each restricted delta is invertible by lem-pur-ringed-site-pullback-dual-free-chart, applied to the supplied source trivialization. The chart theorem handles internal-Hom restriction and finite biproducts internally; no separate dual trivialization is needed. Apply Mathlib Sheaf.isIso_of_coversTop to the underlying additive sheaf map, and reflect the isomorphism along SheafOfModules.toSheaf.

proof_origin.place: Tags 0GMX and 0FNY; pairing-transfer uniqueness for naturality and Mathlib local detection of isomorphisms for descent. The larger-universe module adjoint existence uses lifted free representables and cokernel presentations. Pairing transfer uses localization via uniqueness of left adjoints. The finite-free chart follows by naturality, the unit calculation and preservation of finite biproducts.

lean.note: The coefficient map is represented by its adjunct R → u_*S; the adjoint module pullback is Mathlib’s. Existence of the adjoint is in the conclusion, rather than an extra hypothesis. The unique comparison family is normalized by evaluation on all local unit-image sections, hence is exactly the map induced by the pulled evaluation pairing. Its finite-locally-free isomorphy and contravariant naturality are stated, and the normalization specializes to every pulled-back local dual basis. Independent site object/morphism universes and a common larger sheaf bound are explicit.
